title: Vanishing level-one Fourier weight
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ whose values lie in $[0,1]$. If the mean of $f$ on the cube is zero, then its total Fourier weight at level one is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
